To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
two vasa/ PL10 DEAD-box genes are differentially expressed during gametogenesis and may play a role in genome exclusion and endoreplication of Rana hybrids.

we identified two DEAD-box vaso/PL10 orthologue genes (RlVas and RlPL1O) that are specifically expressed during the early phases of spermatogenesis in the hybridogenetic species R. ridibundo, R. lessona, and their natural triploid hybrid R. escelenta, and are therefore useful markers for the study of the molecular aspects of the genome exclusion and endocelliplication of the hybridogenic gametogenesis.

the two genes are expressed in different phases and in different compartments of the male gametogenesis in three closely related species, including the natural hybrid R. ridibundae × R. lessonae × R. esculentae.
